Communist Party of the United States of America Records

This subseries contains the administrative records of assorted staff members of the CPUSA. The work of many important CPUSA leaders such as William Z. Foster, Eugene Dennis, Benjamin Davis, Sam Webb, William Weinstone, and Henry Winston is documented here. The files of Arnold Becchetti and Lou Diskin, who each served the Party in a variety of capacities, make up a large portion of this subseries. Correspondence files, memos, notes, and reports address a wide range of subject matters including labor issues, member education, international communism, and Marxist theory.
